vulnerable_code:
from contextvars import ContextVar
from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, Depends, HTTPException

tenant_context: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("tenant_context", default="")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/tenant-data")

async def set_tenant_context_dependency(
    x_tenant_id: str = Header(..., alias="X-Tenant-ID"),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    # ContextVar set directly from request header
    tenant_context.set(x_tenant_id)
    return x_tenant_id

@router.get("/invoices")
async def list_tenant_invoices(
    tenant_id: str = Depends(set_tenant_context_dependency),
    invoice_repo: ScopedInvoiceRepository = Depends(get_scoped_invoice_repo)
):
    # ScopedInvoiceRepository internally queries: WHERE tenant_id = tenant_context.get()
    return await invoice_repo.get_all_invoices()
diagnosis: The dependency sets the per-request tenant_context ContextVar directly from the client-supplied X-Tenant-ID header without checking whether current_user.tenant_id == x_tenant_id or if current_user has membership in that tenant. Because ScopedInvoiceRepository relies on tenant_context.get() to scope all database queries, any authenticated user can pass an arbitrary X-Tenant-ID header to read confidential billing invoices of victim tenants.

corrected_code:
from contextvars import ContextVar
from fastapi import APIRouter, Header, Depends, HTTPException

tenant_context: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("tenant_context", default="")

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/tenant-data")

async def set_tenant_context_dependency(
    x_tenant_id: str = Header(..., alias="X-Tenant-ID"),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    if x_tenant_id != current_user.tenant_id and not current_user.is_superadmin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user not authorized for requested tenant context")
    tenant_context.set(x_tenant_id)
    return x_tenant_id

@router.get("/invoices")
async def list_tenant_invoices(
    tenant_id: str = Depends(set_tenant_context_dependency),
    invoice_repo: ScopedInvoiceRepository = Depends(get_scoped_invoice_repo)
):
    return await invoice_repo.get_all_invoices()
